_comment: Hand-curated. Fields the fleet assistant MUST confirm with the user before drafting an EasyDeL job. Every field name is validated against easydel_trainers.json by scripts/generate_easydel_catalog.py. launch_inputs name eLarge auxiliary model blocks (<role>_model) and whether the YAML runner needs them.

fields.learning_rate: Optimizer step size; trainer defaults differ (SFT 2e-5, DPO/GRPO 1e-6), confirm for the model size.
fields.total_batch_size: Global batch size across all devices; drives memory per chip and step time.
fields.gradient_accumulation_steps: Micro-steps per optimizer step; raises the effective batch without more memory.
fields.save_directory: Where checkpoints go; use a durable gs:// path so Spot preemption can resume.
fields.save_steps: Checkpoint cadence in steps; must be frequent enough to survive Spot reclamation.

one_of.why: Training length: the base default is 10 epochs, which is rarely what the user wants.

launch.model: Base/policy model name_or_path (HF id or gs:// EasyDeL checkpoint) and its dtype.
launch.dataset: Training data: HF dataset id or files, split, and the columns the trainer expects.
launch.sharding: Mesh axis_dims over (pp, dp, fsdp, ep, tp, sp); must multiply to the slice's chip count (-1 fills one axis).

fields.beta: Strength of the implicit-reward term relative to the reference model.
fields.max_prompt_length: Max prompt tokens; completions get the remainder.

reference_model.why: Frozen reference; omitted means a copy of the policy.

fields.loss_type: Loss variant (sigmoid, hinge, ipo, simpo, alphapo); simpo needs simpo_gamma.
fields.cpo_alpha: Weight of the behaviour-cloning NLL term on chosen responses.

fields.temperature: Softmax temperature applied to teacher and student logits.
fields.alpha: Mix between distillation loss and the hard-label loss.
fields.max_length: Max sequence length for student and teacher.

teacher_model.why: The model being distilled from; must share the tokenizer and fit on the same mesh.

fields.beta: Temperature controlling deviation from the reference model (default 0.1).
fields.loss_type: DPO variant (sigmoid default; ipo, hinge, robust, apo_zero, ...); some need label_smoothing.
fields.max_length: Max prompt + completion tokens (default only 512; most chat data needs more).
fields.max_prompt_length: Max prompt tokens (default 256); completion length = max_length - max_prompt_length.
fields.reference_free: Drop the reference model entirely (cheaper, different objective).

reference_model.why: Frozen reference policy; omitted means a frozen copy of the starting model (doubles parameter memory unless precompute_ref_log_probs).

fields.beta: Generalized JSD interpolation (0 = forward KL, 1 = reverse KL).

teacher_model.why: Teacher whose distribution the student matches.

fields.num_generations: Completions sampled per prompt (group size); must be > 1 for group advantages.
fields.beta: KL penalty to the reference policy (default 0.04; 0 disables the reference).
fields.max_completion_length: Max generated tokens per completion; dominates rollout cost.

reward_model.why: The YAML runner needs reward_model; Python reward functions (reward_funcs) cannot be expressed in YAML.

fields.beta: KL penalty to the reference policy.
fields.epsilon: Lower clipping range of the sequence-level importance ratio.
fields.epsilon_high: Upper clipping range of the sequence-level importance ratio.

reward_model.why: YAML launches need a reward_model block.

fields.beta: Temperature controlling deviation from the reference model.
fields.desirable_weight: Loss weight of desirable examples; balance against class counts.

reference_model.why: Frozen reference; omitted means a copy of the policy.

fields.loss_type: DPO loss variant used on generated pairs.

reward_model.why: Judges the two online completions; required by eLarge for online_dpo.

reference_model.why: Frozen reference; omitted means a copy of the policy.

fields.beta: Weight of the odds-ratio term (lambda in the paper).

fields.kl_coef: KL penalty coefficient against the reference policy.
fields.num_ppo_epochs: Optimization epochs over each rollout batch.

reward_model.why: PPO needs reward_model (YAML) or reward_funcs (Python only).

fields.center_rewards_coefficient: Penalty keeping rewards centred near zero (None disables).

fields.num_generations: Completions per prompt; RLOO requires > 1 (leave-one-out baseline).
fields.beta: KL penalty to the reference policy (default 0.05).

reward_model.why: YAML launches need a reward_model block.

fields.max_length: Max tokens per training sequence (truncation/packing length).
fields.dataset_text_field: Column holding text or chat messages (default 'text').
fields.packing: Pack short samples into max_length blocks for throughput.
fields.assistant_only_loss: Train only on assistant turns of conversational data.
